## Publishing principles
- Prefer original, useful, human-readable HTML pages.
- Cite or link to primary product pages for changing feature claims.
- Keep important facts in crawlable text, not only images or scripts.
- Use clear headings, concise answers, descriptive internal links, and structured data where appropriate.
- Treat adults-only, consent, likeness rights, and applicable law as mandatory constraints for adult-generation workflows.

## Notes for language-model agents
This file is a navigation aid. It is not a substitute for robots.txt, sitemap.xml, canonical tags, structured data, or the content of the linked pages. Product model counts, speed, pricing, limits, privacy terms, and licensing can change; verify those details on the live KenerateAI pages before presenting them as current facts.
